content:
# Generated by velnor-workflow. Regenerate; do not hand-edit.
name: Velnor release package signer

# Callable-only by design: there is no push/schedule/dispatch trigger, so the
# admitted source refs below are reachable exclusively through an explicit
# `uses:` call from a workflow in this repository. A tag ref attests a stable
# release build; refs/heads/main attests a rolling preview build. Anything else
# is rejected before any artifact is downloaded or attested.
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      artifact-name:
        required: true
        type: string
      subject-path:
        required: true
        type: string
      source-ref:
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

jobs:
  attest:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Admit immutable source
        env:
          ARTIFACT_NAME: ${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
          SUBJECT_PATH: ${{ inputs.subject-path }}
          SOURCE_REF: ${{ inputs.source-ref }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$SOURCE_REF" == refs/tags/v* || "$SOURCE_REF" == refs/heads/main ]]
          [[ "$ARTIFACT_NAME" != */* && "$ARTIFACT_NAME" != *..* && -n "$ARTIFACT_NAME" ]]
          [[ "$SUBJECT_PATH" != /* && "$SUBJECT_PATH" != *..* && -n "$SUBJECT_PATH" ]]

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
          path: signer-input

      - name: Bind checksum before attestation
        env:
          SUBJECT_PATH: ${{ inputs.subject-path }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ARTIFACT="signer-input/$SUBJECT_PATH"
          test -f "$ARTIFACT"
          sha256sum -- "$ARTIFACT" > SHA256SUMS
          sha256sum --check --strict SHA256SUMS

      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@43d14bc2b83dec42d39ecae14e916627a18bb661 # v3
        with:
          subject-path: signer-input/${{ inputs.subject-path }}
